certifications.name: Penetration testing (annual, third-party)
certifications.proof_quote: Penetration Test Report - Aisera Gen AI Platform - 2025 ... Penetration Test Report - Aisera AWS/Azure Infrastructure - 2025 ... Annual Penetration Test

privacy.ai_training_note: No explicit 'we do not train on your data' pledge was found in the public privacy policy. Architecture strongly signals customer data isolation: trust center lists 'Customer Data Segregation' and 'Data Processing Agreements in Place', and the TRAPS governance framework is positioned for data protection. Model customization is per-tenant ('LLM Studio supporting tailored tuning using organizational knowledge'), i.e. tuning scoped to the customer rather than a shared model. Default training stance on customer/business data is not publicly stated; confirm via the executed DPA / MSA before onboarding sensitive data.
privacy.data_region: AWS Oregon (US-West) for primary storage; Microsoft Azure US-West and Europe (EU data kept in EU for EU-based customers). Privacy policy notes data 'may be processed outside your country' and uses third-party servers including the US.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Yes - 'We also encrypt all communications between the Aisera client and our web services.'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Yes - trust center control 'Encryption at Rest'; data within platform encrypted once logged in.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party pen tests for both the Gen AI platform and AWS/Azure infrastructure (2025 reports available in trust center).

security.name: Bug bounty / responsible disclosure
security.value: Responsible disclosure (bug bounty) program listed; no named platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) disclosed publicly.

security.name: Customer data segregation
security.value: Listed as a product security control ('Customer Data Segregation').

security.name: Infrastructure controls
security.value: WAF, IDS, denial of public SSH, firewalls, daily database backups, audit log retention, code review, SDLC, incident response plan/team, security training, cyber insurance.

security.name: Subprocessors (transparency)
security.value: Disclosed: AWS (Oregon), Microsoft Azure (US West / EU + Azure OpenAI when applicable), Zendesk (AWS US-West), Deepgram (speech).

security.name: AI governance framework
security.value: TRAPS framework and a 'Responsible and Ethical AI Development Policy' published; PII anonymization advertised.

products.name: Aisera AI Agent Platform / Aisera Unify / Agent Composer
products.category: Enterprise agentic AI platform (build & run AI agents)
products.data_scope: Ingests enterprise knowledge bases, ITSM/HR/Finance system data; cloud-hosted on AWS/Azure; per-tenant segregation; DPA + subprocessor disclosure.
products.notes: Core platform. Customers can use Aisera's proprietary LLM or bring their own model; LLM Studio supports per-org tuning.

products.name: Aisera Assistant / AI Agents for IT, ITSM, HR, Finance, Procurement
products.data_scope: Connects to enterprise systems (e.g. ServiceNow, MS Teams, Epic/Cerner/Salesforce for healthcare); processes employee/IT support data, potentially PII/PHI under BAA.
products.notes: Healthcare deployments operate under HIPAA/BAA. Permission-aware retrieval.

products.name: AiseraGPT / Generative AI Copilot (incl. Legal & Compliance)
products.data_scope: Analyzes internal documents/contracts; permission-aware; governed by TRAPS for data exfiltration prevention and anomaly detection.
products.notes: Used for legal research, e-discovery, contract drafting; emphasizes data-mapping and privacy compliance.

products.name: AIOps
products.data_scope: Telemetry, logs, and ITSM data for proactive incident prediction.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise / custom quote (RFP-based, 'Submit RFP' / 'Get a customized quote'); no public self-serve pricing.
compare.data_residency: US default (AWS Oregon); EU data residency available for EU customers via Azure EU regions.

flags: Acquired by Automation Anywhere on 2025-11-04; aisera.com/platform/security-and-compliance now 301-redirects to automationanywhere.com/products/security. Compliance ownership and certification scope may transition to the parent over time; re-verify trust documents under the new entity.
Bug bounty exists as a 'responsible disclosure' program but no named platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) is publicly identified.

Public privacy policy does not explicitly state the model-training stance on customer/business data; segregation controls are present but the 'no training by default' guarantee should be confirmed in the executed DPA.

Most certification artifacts (ISO cert, SOC 2 report, pen-test reports) are gated behind the Drata-powered trust center and require an NDA/request to download; titles are publicly listed but full reports were not directly read.
